# BurstTemporalPlasticity

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning rule that adjusts synaptic weights based on the precise temporal patterns of burst events across pre- and post-synaptic neurons. Provides a biologically plausible mechanism for online learning in neuromorphic systems, supporting adaptive in-network computation.
